$ edit testdata/script/nameless.txtar  # an archive with no description
$ edit testdata/script/loopy.txtar  # a case with a property and a gaps line nothing declares
$ edit testdata/script/typo.txtar  # an archive with a problem of form
$ edit testdata/script/old/x.txtar  # an archive in no corpus's directory
$ edit testdata/renamed/x.txtar  # an archive in a directory no registry declares
$ edit testdata/x.txtar  # an archive directly in testdata/
$ go test ./b  # pkg-b
    testdata/script/typo.txtar has problems of form, so none of its cells run, and no update writes it. The root-package check reports them.

$ go test  # pkg-a
    testdata/ holds archives directly, and an archive belongs in a corpus's directory, testdata/<corpus>/.
        Move the archives into one.
    testdata/renamed/ holds archives, and no registry declares the directory: no corpus type has it as its Dir, and no suite names it as its Corpus.
        Declare a decl.Type with that Dir, or move or delete the archives.
    testdata/script/old/ holds archives, and no registry declares the directory: no corpus type has it as its Dir, and no suite names it as its Corpus.
        Declare a decl.Type with that Dir, or move or delete the archives.
    testdata/script/loopy.txtar: properties states loopy, and no registry under the module-root corpus lists a property of that name.
        Declare the property, or correct the line.
    testdata/script/loopy.txtar: gaps, line 1, names format, and no registry has a column of that name over the corpus script.
        Register the column, or remove the line.
    testdata/script/nameless.txtar: the archive has no description: its comment, the text before the first section, is empty
        Write the case's description, in prose, as the archive's comment, the text before its first section.
    testdata/script/typo.txtar has problems of form, so none of its cells run, and no update writes it:
          ni/do/out/values.txt: ni is not one of the framework's top-level names (gaps, in, out, properties, transform, variant, via)
        Fix the archive by hand.
    testdata/script/typo.txtar has problems of form, so none of its cells run, and no update writes it. The root-package check reports them.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
